key_idea: Half are cats when there are as many cats as other animals.
steps: The animals that are not cats are 2 dogs and 1 rabbit. 2 + 1 = 3.
For half to be cats, there must be 3 cats too.
Check: 3 cats and 3 other animals make 6 animals, and half of 6 is 3.

choice_feedback.A: With 1 more cat she has 2 cats and 3 other animals. That is not half.
choice_feedback.C: With 3 more cats she has 4 cats and 3 other animals. That is more than half.
choice_feedback.D: With 4 more cats she has 5 cats and 3 other animals. That is more than half.
choice_feedback.E: With 5 more cats she has 6 cats and 3 other animals. That is more than half.
